meta.title: Zoom control changes QCS text size

steps.note: Open a prepared QCS containing vendor quotes.

args.goal: On the QCS, use the zoom control to zoom in and verify from screenshots that the QCS text renders larger, then use the same zoom control to zoom out and verify that the text renders smaller

steps.note: Perform and visually verify both zoom directions on the QCS.
Confirm the QCS remains rendered without errors or visual corruption after zooming.
